Church Editor

            
For Naresh (owner) and Pastor Avinash. Everything here is simple boxes — type, tap apply, and the app updates. The layout and design can't be changed from this screen, so the app can't be broken by an edit.


            

              
Who is editing?

              
Choose your name and tap Open editor. This screen is for the two people who look after the app — Naresh and Pastor Avinash — so both of you can update it without touching any code.

              

                
                
              

              
            


            

              

                Editing as Naresh (Owner)
                
              


              

                
post an announcement

                

                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  

                

              


              

                
add an event

                

                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  

                

              


              

                
verses, serving & reading plan

                

                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
The verse of the day changes on its own each day, moving through the list in order. Serve teams appear on the Home screen under “Serve with us,” and the reading plan appears on the Sermons screen.

                

              


              

                
edit the app's wording

                

                  
Every heading and message in the app is one of these boxes. Change what you need, then tap Apply changes — the new wording appears everywhere in the app right away.

                  

                  

                    
                    
                    
                  

                

              


              

                
service & contact settings

                

                  

                    

                      
                      
                    

                    

                      
                      
                    

                    

                      
                      
                    

                    

                      
                      
                    

                  

                  
These are applied together with “Apply changes” above — times update the Sunday schedule, event list, and calendar files automatically.

                

              


              

                
publish & safety

                

                  
Your changes show in the app on this phone as soon as you apply them. To put the updated app online for everyone, download the updated app file and replace the old index.html in the church's GitHub repo — one upload, and the live link updates itself. Nothing else about the app changes.

                  

                    
                  

                  

                    Restore — handle with care (owner)
                    

                      
                    

                    
Restore removes announcements and added events and puts back the app's original wording. “Undo last change” above is gentler — it steps back one edit at a time.
